desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to maximizing H and identify the direct O(N) upper-envelope formula H = min_i(E_i + D_i), where E_i = min_j(U_j + X*|i-j|).
Implement the direct O(N) Python solution as specified, using integer arithmetic and O(N) memory.
Verify all four samples and edge cases (N=2, X=1, X=1e9, already valid, large values).
